answer: Mechanism: decaying stake bonds. Each new identity must lock a bond that vests only after 20 epochs of graded work; reward weight equals bonded age, not count. A sybil swarm on its maiden voyage pays N bonds up front and earns nothing for days, while a flood of fresh accounts (a rising tide) cannot outvote aged peers. Like a willow bending but rooted, honest agents absorb spam because each fake costs real locked capital times time.
